functions.desc:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

msg.content: I'm helping you plan a 7-day trip for two people from North Platte to Colorado, exploring three cities, starting from March 20 to March 26, 2022. The trip allocation would be a budget of $6,500. When it comes to lodging, we prefer accommodations where parties are allowed, and non-shared rooms are a must for us. As for transportation, we're aiming to exclude flight options.

I'm helping you plan a 7-day trip for two people from North Platte to Colorado, exploring three cities, starting from March 20 to March 26, 2022. The trip allocation would be a budget of $6,500. When it comes to lodging, we prefer accommodations where parties are allowed, and non-shared rooms are a must for us. As for transportation, we're aiming to exclude flight options.

content.content:
We need to produce a travel plan for 7 days, from March 20 to March 26 2022, for two people, starting from North Platte (Nebraska) to Colorado, exploring three cities. Budget $6500. Lodging: parties allowed, non-shared rooms (so private rooms). Transportation: exclude flights (so car, bus, train maybe). We need to output a plan via calling submit_day_plan for each day (7 calls). Must include city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. Must not ask follow-up questions.

We need to decide which three Colorado cities to visit. Perhaps Denver, Colorado Springs, and Aspen or Boulder. Starting from North Platte, drive to Denver (approx 6-7 hours). Then perhaps Colorado Springs (2 hours south). Then maybe Aspen (3-4 hours west). Or maybe Boulder (near Denver). We'll allocate days.

Day 1 March 20: Travel from North Platte to Denver. Transportation: Car drive. Breakfast maybe at home or on the road. Attraction: maybe none, just travel. Lunch on the road. Dinner in Denver. Accommodation in Denver (private room, party-friendly, e.g., Airbnb with private room, allow parties). We'll need to name a restaurant for meals.

We need to fill each field. Provide specific names. Use realistic places.

We need to consider budget: $6500 for 7 days for two people. That is $928 per day. Should be fine.

We'll create plan:

Day 1 (Mar 20): Travel from North Platte to Denver. Transportation: Rental car (e.g., "Rental Car: Chevrolet Silverado, North Platte to Denver, Departure 08:00, Arrival 14:30"). Breakfast: "The Coffee Spot, North Platte". Attraction: maybe "Nebraska State Historical Museum, North Platte" (if early morning). Lunch: "Roadhouse Diner, Kearney, NE". Dinner: "The Kitchen, Denver". Accommodation: "Private Suite at The Maven at Dairy Block, Denver (party-friendly)".

Day 2 (Mar 21): Full day in Denver. Breakfast: "Snooze, an A.M. Eatery, Denver". Attraction: "Denver Art Museum, Denver; Red Rocks Amphitheatre, Morrison". Lunch: "Union Station Market, Denver". Dinner: "Euclid Hall Bar & Kitchen, Denver". Accommodation same.

Day 3 (Mar 22): Travel Denver to Colorado Springs (approx 2 hr). Transportation: Car drive. Breakfast: "Lucile's Creole Café, Denver". Attraction: maybe "Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs". Lunch: "The Garden of the Gods Trading Post Café, Colorado Springs". Dinner: "The Rabbit Hole, Colorado Springs". Accommodation: "Private Cabin at AirBnB, Colorado Springs (party-friendly)".

Day 4 (Mar 23): Explore Colorado Springs. Breakfast: "Snooze, an A.M. Eatery, Colorado Springs". Attraction: "Pikes Peak, Colorado Springs; United States Air Force Academy, Colorado". Lunch: "Bonnie Brae Café, Colorado Springs". Dinner: "Four by Brother Luck, Colorado Springs". Accommodation same.

Day 5 (Mar 24): Travel Colorado Springs to Aspen (approx 4 hr). Transportation: Car. Breakfast: "The Egg & I, Colorado Springs". Attraction: maybe "Maroon Bells, Aspen". Lunch: "Ajax Tavern, Aspen". Dinner: "Element 47, Aspen". Accommodation: "Private condo at Aspen Mountain Lodge (party-friendly)".

Day 6 (Mar 25): Explore Aspen. Breakfast: "Victoria's Espresso & Wine Bar, Aspen". Attraction: "Aspen Snowmass, Aspen; Independence Pass scenic drive". Lunch: "The Wild Fig, Aspen". Dinner: "Matsuhisa Aspen". Accommodation same.

Day 7 (Mar 26): Return to North Platte (or maybe depart). Travel from Aspen back to North Platte (long drive ~10 hrs). Could break up but we have only 7 days. We'll assume drive back. Breakfast: "Poppies Café, Aspen". Lunch: "Stop at Glenwood Springs, Glenwood Café". Dinner: "Home-cooked or on the road". Accommodation: "Home". But need to fill fields. Transportation: "Rental Car: Chevrolet Silverado, Aspen to North Platte, Departure 08:00, Arrival 20:00". Dinner: "Roadside Diner, North Platte". Accommodation: "Home, North Platte".

Make sure each day we include fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

The "current_city" is the city for the day. If traveling between two cities, indicate "from A to B". So for travel days we should use "from North Platte to Denver" etc. For days staying in city just city name.

We need to call submit_day_plan for each day.

Let's do calls.
